id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

workOrderOrPurchaseOrderDelta.description:
The {@link WorkOrder} or {@link PurchaseOrderLine} that impacts the forecasted quantiy of the {@link #part}.
A Work Order subtracts from the inventory whereas a PurchaseOrder adds to the inventory.

inventoryActual.description: The actual quantity of the part available on the {@link #forecastDate}.

inventoryRequested.description:
The quantity of the #part requested to be added or subtracted
from the {@link PurchaseOrder} or {@link WorkOrder}.  This can be a
negative number if the `inventory` is being deducted from the `workOrder`

forecastDate.description:
Forecase date is always a date in the future (from the current date) use to
predict the quantity of the {@link #part} available/quantity.

part.description:
The {@link InventorySeries} that is forecasted to quantify how much `inventory`
will be available on the #forecastDate.

workOrderId.description:
Represents the {@link WorkOrder} ID if forecast was based on {@link WorkOrder}.
`Empty` indicates that the forecast was based on {@link PurchaseOrder}.
It is used to identify the number of unique {@link WorkOrder}s that are impacted due to a missing part.

title:
This type forecasts the expected part inventory for a specific {@link WorkOrder} or {@link PurchaseOrder}
At a future date.
name: WorkOrderPartsForecast
